steps: \lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^{{a}x} - e^{{b}x}}{x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)

\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^{{a}x} - e^{{b}x}}{\sin(x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{{k}\left(e^x + e^{-x} - 2\right)}{x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^{-2\sin x} - e^{\tan x}}{{k}(x^3 + x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
= \lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{1}{{k}(x^2 + 1)} \cdot \left(-2 \cdot \dfrac{\sin x}{x} \cdot \dfrac{e^{-2\sin x} - 1}{-2\sin x} - \dfrac{\tan x}{x} \cdot \dfrac{e^{\tan x} - 1}{\tan x}\right)
checkpoints: \dfrac{1}{{k}(x^2 + 1)} \cdot \left(-2 \cdot \dfrac{\sin x}{x} \cdot \dfrac{e^{-2\sin x} - 1}{-2\sin x} - \dfrac{\tan x}{x} \cdot \dfrac{e^{\tan x} - 1}{\tan x}\right)

steps: \lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^{{k}x} - e^{-{k}x}}{\sin(2x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^x + e^{2x} + e^{3x} - 3}{x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(e^{{a}x} - x\right) \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \infty - \infty\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \left(1 + {k}\cos x\right)^{\frac{1}{x - \frac{\pi}{2}}} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } 1^\infty\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \left(\dfrac{e^{{a}x} + e^{{b}x}}{2}\right)^{\dfrac{1}{x}} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } 1^\infty\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{(e^{-x} + e^x)\sin^2({a}x)}{2x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to +\infty} \left({a}x^2 + x + \ln(x)\right) \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \infty - \infty\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \left({a}x^2 + 2x - x\ln(x)\right) \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \infty - \infty\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(3\ln(x) - {a}x^2 + x\right) \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \infty - \infty\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \dfrac{x^2 - x \ln(x) + {k}}{x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{\infty}{\infty}\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \dfrac{{a}\ln(x) + x^2 - 2}{-x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{\infty}{\infty}\right)
\lim_{x \to \infty} \dfrac{{a}x^2 - x\ln(x)}{x^2 - x + \ln(x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{\infty}{\infty}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{x\ln(1 + {a}x) + {b}\ln(1 + x^2)}{x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\ln(1 + {a}x^2) - x\ln(1 - {b}x)}{{k}x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\ln(2 + x\sin({a}x) - \cos({b}x))}{x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\ln\left(2 - e^{-x^2}\cos({a}x)\right)}{x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to {a}} \dfrac{{k}{a}^4 - {k}x^4}{{a}^2 - x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to {a}} \dfrac{x^3 - {a}x^2 + x - {a}}{2x^2 - {b}x + {a}} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{x + x^2 + x^3 - 3}{x + x^2 - 2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to +\infty} \dfrac{{a}x^2 - x + 1}{{p}x^2 + {q}} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{\infty}{\infty}\right)
\lim_{x \to {p}} \dfrac{\sqrt{x + {a}} - {b}}{{p} - x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\sqrt{1 + x} - \sqrt{1 - x}}{{k}x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
= \lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\left(\sqrt{1 + x} - \sqrt{1 - x}\right)\left(\sqrt{1 + x} + \sqrt{1 - x}\right)}{{k}x\left(\sqrt{1 + x} + \sqrt{1 - x}\right)}
checkpoints: \dfrac{\left(\sqrt{1 + x} - \sqrt{1 - x}\right)\left(\sqrt{1 + x} + \sqrt{1 - x}\right)}{{k}x\left(\sqrt{1 + x} + \sqrt{1 - x}\right)}

steps: \lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\sqrt{{a}} - \sqrt{{a} - x}}{{a}x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)

\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\sqrt{{a} + x} - \sqrt[3]{{a}^3 + {k}x}}{{m}x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)

\lim_{x \to \pi} \dfrac{{k}x + {k}\pi\cos(x)}{\pi - x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \dfrac{\pi}{2}} \dfrac{{k}x - {k}\dfrac{\pi}{2}\sin(x)}{\dfrac{\pi}{2} - x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to {a}} \dfrac{\sin(\pi x)}{x^2 - {a}x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)

\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{{k}(1 + \cos(\pi x))}{(1 - x)^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{{k}\left(1 - \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right)\right)}{(1 - x)^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \pi} \dfrac{{k}\left(1 - \sin\left(\dfrac{x}{2}\right)\right)}{\pi - x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{{k}\tan(\pi x)}{1 - x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \pi} \dfrac{{k}(\pi - x)}{\cot\left(\dfrac{x}{2}\right)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}(\sin x - \cos x)}{\pi - 4x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 1} \dfrac{{k}\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right)}{x^2 - 1} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \dfrac{{k}(1 + \cos(2x))}{\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - x\right)^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 2} \dfrac{{k}\sin(\pi x)}{1 - \dfrac{x^2}{4}} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \dfrac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}(\sin x - \cos x)}{\cos(2x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
= \lim_{x \to \dfrac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{-{k}(\cos x - \sin x)}{(\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)}
\lim_{x \to \dfrac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}\left(x - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)}{\cos x - \sin x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \dfrac{2{k}\sin\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)}{1 - 2\cos x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 2} \dfrac{{k}(4 - x^2)\sin\left(\frac{\pi x}{4}\right)}{\cos\left(\frac{\pi x}{4}\right)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}(1 - \tan x)}{1 - \sqrt{2}\sin x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}(\cos x - \sin x)(1 + \sqrt{2}\sin x)}{\cos x (\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)}
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \dfrac{{k}(\pi - 3x)}{\sqrt{3} - 2\sin x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}\left(1 - \sqrt{2}\cos x\right)}{1 - \sqrt{2}\sin x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)

= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}\left(1 - \sqrt{2}\cos x\right)\left(1 + \sqrt{2}\cos x\right)\left(1 + \sqrt{2}\sin x\right)}{\left(1 - \sqrt{2}\sin x\right)\left(1 + \sqrt{2}\sin x\right)\left(1 + \sqrt{2}\cos x\right)}
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}\cos(2x)}{\cos x - \sin x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
= \lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{4}} \dfrac{{k}(\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x)}{\cos x - \sin x}
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}} \dfrac{{k}(2\sin x - 1)}{1 - 2\cos(2x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \dfrac{{k}(2\cos x - 1)}{2\cos(2x) + 1} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \dfrac{{k}\left(2\cos(2x) + 1\right)}{\sqrt{2\cos x} - 1} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{2}} \dfrac{{k}\left(1 - \sin x\right)}{\cos^2 x} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{\sin^2({a}x) + x\sin({b}x)}{{d}x^2} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to 0} \dfrac{{k}\left(3\tan x - \tan(3x)\right)}{x^3} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}} \dfrac{\sin x - \sqrt{3}\cos x}{{k}(\pi - 3x)} \quad \left(\text{រាងមិនកំណត់ } \dfrac{0}{0}\right)
